project.name: Potbelly Sandwich Works: 29281 Katy Fwy #110, Houston, TX 77094

source_derived_facts: The drawing set identifies Potbelly Sandwich Works and the project address.
The set contains E3.0 Lighting Plan and E5.0 Lighting Schedules.
The set identifies Bob Conwell and email contacts including Amy Pettie at Potbelly and Bob Conwell at NewQuest.
The lighting schedule contains fixture tags, quantities, types, manufacturers, descriptions, models, lamps, furnish/install responsibility, voltage, wattage and comments.
A lighting responsibility note states that light fixtures are furnished by the owner, installed by the general contractor, and wired by the electrical contractor unless otherwise noted.
The electrical notes reference E5.0 for the complete lighting schedule and identify GC responsibility for relays at track lighting.
